2608.26035.title: Beyond Local Surprise: Grounded Dialogue as Selective Belief Revision under Referential Uncertainty
2608.26035.paper_summary: When a speaker refers to a scene that the listener cannot directly see, the listener must decide whether to preserve its current understanding or revise it as new utterances arrive. Many language systems treat local mismatch as a cue for updating: divergence from the current understanding encourages adjustment. Yet conversational understanding may be more conservative, interpreting mismatching evidence relative to prior understanding rather than immediately revising it. We introduce a controlled, data-driven framework for turn-by-turn preserve/revise decisions in dialogue, where competing revision policies are learned under otherwise identical conditions. We compare four theory-driven revision strategies, each reflecting a different assumption about when listeners should preserve or revise. Two findings stand out. First, a mismatch-driven policy that updates solely based on local divergence reacts strongly to mismatch but destabilizes grounding and degrades retrieval. Second, an uncertainty-sensitive policy extends mismatch-based updating with accumulated evidence, preserving coherent understanding while maintaining strong retrieval performance. Surprisingly, coherent understanding emerges from a counterintuitive pattern: local mismatch promotes preservation, whereas accumulated uncertainty promotes revision, suggesting that listeners maintain prior understanding despite local mismatch and revise only when uncertainty sufficiently accumulates. This pattern is consistent with conceptual pact theory.
2608.26035.paper_summary_zh: 當講者提到聽者無法直接看到的場景時，聽者必須決定是保留目前的理解還是隨著新話語的到來進行修正。許多語言系統將局部不匹配視為更新的提示：與當前理解的偏差鼓勵調整。然而，對話理解可能更為保守，將不匹配的證據相對於先前的理解進行解釋，而不是立即進行修正。我們引入了一個受控的、數據驅動的框架，用於對話中的逐輪保留/修正決策，其中競爭的修正政策在其他條件相同的情況下進行學習。我們比較了四種理論驅動的修正策略，每種策略反映了對聽者何時應該保留或修正的不同假設。有兩個發現特別突出。首先，基於不匹配的政策僅根據局部偏差進行更新，對不匹配反應強烈，但會破壞基礎並降低檢索效果。其次，一種對不確定性感知的政策擴展了基於不匹配的更新，通過積累的證據來保留一致的理解，同時保持強大的檢索性能。令人驚訝的是，一致的理解源於一種反直覺的模式：局部不匹配促進保留，而積累的不確定性促進修正，這表明聽者在局部不匹配的情況下仍然保持先前的理解，只有在不確定性充分積累時才進行修正。這一模式與概念契約理論一致。
